summary: All SPEC items are implemented as specified. The deviations format is optional (absent gives []), and parseStyle validates street/advice/instead pairs, duplicate pairs, probability (via the existing isProbability) and justification, collecting every problem and echoing at most 20 characters. tag.json and the locked TASK-6.2 tests are unchanged and pass. decideCallingStation draws exactly once, and only when a deviation applies and a generator is passed (u < p*2^32 via drawDeviation, which applies to 0 and 1 too). It plays check when nothing is owed (A-4) and never folds at 0 owed. Worker dispatch sends 'Calling station' to decideCallingStation and every other style to decideTag. I probed SPEC-10's views: seeds 12345 and 4294967295 at the preflop view give call vs raise, so that test would catch a wrong dispatch. The SPEC-06 locked test also pins Example A to call 2 vs raise 8. The AC#2/#3/#4 tests assert that every point is a real fold/raise-with-owed point, that the station's move is the advice or the legal call, and that call counts relate as specified, so they're non-vacuous. Re-ran tests/bots and advice-service: 38/38 pass. Playtest stdout SHA-256 = aacd5e94...8e01, which matches the baseline, and the default line-ups are untouched. The size overrun (840 vs 650) is mostly the 394-line locked acceptance test. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
